name: Grilled lake shrimp
summary: Shrimp grilled with the lake fish until both turn golden. The Thái Nguyên portal names tôm nướng beside cá nướng as a dish of the lake. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: The lake table. Thái Nguyên provincial portal, 1 April 2026.
howToEat: The portal grills the shrimp with the fish. When the shrimp and the fish turn golden, they are ready. A dipping sauce was not printed for the shrimp.
A price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Pac Ngoi and the lake houses. The portal does not name a stall.
seoTitle: Grilled lake shrimp at Ba Be
seoDescription: Tôm nướng, grilled with the lake fish until golden. The Thái Nguyên portal names it. A price is Check on arrival.
